source_clause: EDPR5.1) The screen will show the currently selected Avatar highlighted and provide the option to choose from all other available avatars
leaf_desc_037: EDPR5.1) The screen will show the currently selected Avatar highlighted and provide the option to choose from all other available avatars
reasoning: 驗證目標：9.4.1（EDPR5.1）—— 選擇畫面須標示目前 avatar，並提供其餘可用 avatar。關鍵情境條件：pre-condition 要求該 profile 已有 avatar，否則「目前之 avatar」無從觀察。為什麼這樣切：畫面之開啟屬 9.4，本 leaf 只管其內容。

tcs.tc_title: Current avatar highlighted among the available avatars
tcs.test_item: Current avatar highlighted among the available avatars
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A Driver Profile with a selected avatar is active
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the avatar selection screen from the “Edit Profile” tab
2. Read the screen and check that the current avatar is highlighted
tcs.expected_result:
1. The avatar selection screen is displayed
2. The currently selected avatar is highlighted and all other available avatars are offered
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
